summary: This section establishes the general statutory duty of an employer to pay a redundancy payment to an employee. It applies where the employee is either dismissed by reason of redundancy or qualifies after being laid off or kept on short-time. This primary obligation operates subject to other relevant provisions contained within this Part of the Act.

elements.requirement: The employer must make a redundancy payment to their employee.
elements.quote: An employer shall pay a redundancy payment to any employee of his

elements.requirement: The employee is dismissed by the employer because of redundancy.
elements.quote: is dismissed by the employer by reason of redundancy

elements.requirement: Alternatively, the employee is eligible for the payment due to lay-off or short-time.
elements.quote: is eligible for a redundancy payment by reason of being laid off or kept on short-time

elements.requirement: The general obligation to pay is subject to the other specified statutory rules and limitations in this Part.
